tip_title: Umbrella Insurance Doesn't Just Kick In for Big Disasters. It Covers the Everyday Stuff Too.
topic: Umbrella Insurance - Who Needs It and When
blurb:
💡 **Insurance Tip: Umbrella Insurance Doesn't Just Kick In for Big Disasters. It Covers the Everyday Stuff Too.**

Most people think umbrella insurance is for wealthy people with fancy cars and sprawling estates. The reality is simpler than that. If someone slips at your house, your dog bites a neighbor, or you're at fault in a car accident that exceeds your auto policy's liability limit, your umbrella policy is what pays the difference between what your standard policy covers and what you actually owe. Standard home and auto liability limits top out faster than you'd expect when medical bills and legal fees start stacking up. One important detail worth knowing: umbrella coverage only applies going forward from the date you buy it, so waiting until after an incident isn't an option.

Not sure if your current liability limits leave you exposed? Your Peachy agent can walk through what you have now and whether an umbrella makes sense for your situation.

📖 [Learn more from NerdWallet](https://www.nerdwallet.com/insurance/homeowners/learn/umbrella-insurance)
